Enter Part 2 version codes

Paste one student report per line, from the randomized Part 2 exam. A bare version code works, and so does a full row copied from a spreadsheet. Lines without a version code (such as a header row) are skipped.

Full row, to verify a report: Name, Attempt, Version code, Section A, Section B, Check code
Commas or tabs both work. Example: Juan Dela Cruz, 1, Q7RX-M2KD, 42.5, 50, 1A2B3C4D
Quick lookup: Q7RX-M2KD or Juan Dela Cruz Q7RX-M2KD
Your list is kept in this browser only.

Every well-formed code produces an exam, so the check code is what confirms a report is genuine. A shared code means two or more names carry the same exam version, which usually points to a copied report.
